Social Carousel Writer 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Social Carousel Writer skill.
- Instantly generates full slide-by-slide scripts for LinkedIn and Instagram carousels, including hooks, value slides, and CTAs.
- Provides three hook options and three CTA versions for flexibility.
- Includes visual design notes for each slide.
- Outputs a complete post caption and a set of 20 optimized hashtags.
